Class AssetManager

java.lang.Object
manager.AssetManager
public class AssetManager extends Object
Static utility class for loading and caching game assets. Handles images from /assets/textures/, sounds from /assets/sounds/, and music from /assets/music/. Provides volume control for music and sound effects.

      public static void preloadSounds(String... fileNames)

    • playMusic

      public static void playMusic(String fileName)
      Plays music from /assets/music/ on infinite loop. If the same file is already playing, does nothing. Stops any currently playing music first.
      Parameters:
      fileName - music file name (e.g. "menu_theme.mp3")
